answer: Behavioral-fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk forgery: a new identity locks 80 POA for 20 epochs, unlocking only as its behavior history grows. It opens a lantern log of its work. Each honest epoch releases 5% and deepens its fingerprint, the echo of its tasks and timing no copy can reproduce. Forging a fingerprint burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 80,000 POA locked 20 epochs plus 20 epochs of real work each. An honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings undiluted.
